arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT l.CRP) FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.CRP LIKE '%+%') AS plus_marked_values,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.Description IS NULL) AS null_descriptions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE trim(p.Description) = '') AS blank_descriptions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.Description IS NOT NULL AND date(p.Description) IS NULL) AS nondate_descriptions
FROM Patient AS p;

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NULL
  AND l.CRP LIKE '%+%'
LIMIT 1
